author: sonnet
label: seeded-01-01
changes: Rewrote the document in the newcomer layout: summary, terms, diagram, numbered steps, failure table, open questions.
Connected the diagram: etl_watermark, etl_runs, the 06:00 check, alerts, retry/page and reconciliation now have labelled arrows.
Defined etl_watermark and etl_runs (contents, writer, reader) and said the mark moves in the same transaction as the merge (Q2, Q7).
Spelled out merge logic: dedupe by highest updated_at, upsert only if not older, is_deleted from deleted_at (Q3, Q5).
Explained how the 2h lookback combines with the mark and why repeated pulls are harmless (Q4).
Made retry concrete: whole run rerun, 2 more times, 15 minutes apart, then page; added a failure table (Q6).
Defined what the 06:00 check reads and does, and that it does not stop the job (Q7).
Defined reconciliation compare-and-reload and its failure handling; it does not move the mark (Q8).
Added open questions: how on-call is paged, and whether a failed reconciliation should page.
Intro: said Sunday reconciliation runs in the same run after a successful merge.
Terms: added 'Night' definition and the first-run seed of the mark (1970-01-01).
Diagram: Sunday reconciliation is now started by merge on Sundays; reconciliation failure goes to #data-alerts; crash or timeout feeds the retry.
Step 1: next attempt marks a leftover running row for the night as failed.
Step 3: reconciliation continues the Sunday run after merge, so it cannot clash with staging use; failure is not retried.

Failure table: added crash/timeout handling, stale-dashboard window and manual rerun after the third failure, skipped reconciliation when Sunday's nightly fails, and how the 06:00 check matches tonight's run.
Open questions: added the per-attempt time limit.
Merged the Terms bullet on seeding the mark into one shorter line ('starts at 1970-01-01').
Gave each step the same parts (starts, does, keeps data in, on failure) as bullets, instead of mixed prose.
Removed repeated failure detail from step text (rollback consequences, 'Nothing in fact_orders has changed yet') and left failure handling to the table and one-line step entries.
Shortened the failure table rows (merged 'separate write' wording, dropped duplicate 'Nothing else reruns automatically').
Kept the diagram unchanged, with summary and terms before it and steps after it.
